summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by HDFC Bank Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of a postal ballot (e-voting) on a special resolution. The filing includes the scrutinizer's report and confirms that the resolution was approved by the requisite majority on May 20, 2026. No specific details about the resolution's subject matter are provided in the excerpt. This is a standard procedural disclosure related to shareholder voting, not a special situation event. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or any other special-situations category.
